mapper.select: SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, USER_ID, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, SERVICE_TYPE, AGENT_SERIAL, CLIENT_SERIAL, USER_TYPE, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, EMAIL, TEL_NO, REFRESH_TOKEN, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE, VISIT, LOGIN_DATE, PASSWORD_DATE, MEMO FROM CM_MEMBERSHIP WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND USE_BIT = 'Y' AND USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, USER_ID, REFRESH_TOKEN, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE, USER_TYPE, SERVICE_TYPE FROM CM_MEMBERSHIP WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND USE_BIT = 'Y' AND REFRESH_TOKEN = #{refreshToken}
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_MEMBERSHIP SET VISIT = IFNULL(VISIT, 0) + 1, LOGIN_DATE = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
